nodes.summary: For real numbers $a$ and $L$, the double-log bound holds when every continuous function $u : \mathbb{T} \to \mathbb{R}$ on the torus $\mathbb{T} = (\mathbb{R}/2\pi\mathbb{Z})^2$ that is a zero-mean $H^2$ function, has gradient energy $E(u) > 0$ and has frequency ratio $\delta(u) \ge 1$ (the Laplacian energy divided by $E(u)$) satisfies, at every point $x \in \mathbb{T}$,
nodes.title: Double-log bound with coefficient $a$ and constant $L$

nodes.summary: For real numbers $c$ and $K$, the one-log bound holds when every continuous function $u : \mathbb{T} \to \mathbb{R}$ on the torus $\mathbb{T} = (\mathbb{R}/2\pi\mathbb{Z})^2$ that is a zero-mean $H^2$ function, has gradient energy $E(u) > 0$ and has frequency ratio $\delta(u) \ge 1$ (the Laplacian energy divided by $E(u)$) satisfies, at every point $x \in \mathbb{T}$,
nodes.title: One-log bound with coefficient $c$ and constant $K$

nodes.summary: The infimum, taken in the extended reals, of all real numbers $c$ for which there is a real constant $K$ such that the one-log bound with coefficient $c$ and constant $K$ holds. It is $+\infty$ when no such $c$ exists.
nodes.title: Optimal one-log coefficient

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
